messages.content:
Reword the question so that it asks exactly the same thing in different words and a different sentence
structure. Keep every name, model, position number, article number, date and condition exactly. Do not add or
remove any detail. Return only the reworded question.

The verifications covered by the IGEA technical sheet are periodic verifications after the first one: under the Ministerial Decree of 11 April 2011, which body is in charge of them and within how many days from the request must they be carried out?

response.text: Under the Ministerial Decree of 11 April 2011, which body is responsible for the periodic verifications that follow the first one, as covered by the IGEA technical sheet, and within how many days of the request must they be performed?
